gloss: to stop; to halt; to suspend

definitions.gloss: to stop; to halt; to come to a standstill
definitions.explanation: To cease moving or operating. Used for machinery, vehicles, systems, and bodily functions.

definitions.gloss: to suspend; to discontinue; to put on hold
definitions.explanation: To officially halt or suspend an activity, service, or operation.

notes:
A ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb composed of {停|てい} (stop) + {止|し} (cease). A formal, written-style word for stopping or halting. Both transitive (to stop something) and intransitive (something stops) uses are common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{一時|いちじ}{停止|ていし}→一時停止：05401_ichijiteishi⟧: temporary stop/pause
- ⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧⟦{停止|ていし}→停止：04067_teishi⟧: shutdown (of a machine/plant)
- ⟦{免許|めんきょ}→免許：03808_menkyo⟧⟦{停止|ていし}→停止：04067_teishi⟧: license suspension
- ⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{停止|ていし}する: to cease activities
- ⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧⟦{停止|ていし}→停止：04067_teishi⟧: emergency stop

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{止|と}まる→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧ / ⟦{止|と}める→止める：00678_tomeru⟧: to stop — everyday equivalent; less formal
- ⟦{中止|ちゅうし}する→中止する：21909_chuushisuru⟧: to cancel, to call off — stopping something planned before or during execution
- ⟦{中断|ちゅうだん}する→中断する：18998_chuudansuru⟧: to interrupt, to break off — implies temporary interruption with possible resumption
